Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You flick a hooked tool into the missile’s path, trusting the angle and the length of the line more than your reflexes.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, before a defense roll against one physical projectile attack.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires held craft tools and a free hand; grants craft tools, Bulk 1, if absent.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Defense

Use Knowledge instead of the normal defense attribute and gain 1 Boon to this defense. Make only the existing defense roll. This does not work against an area attack or a projectile larger than your own footprint.
